 * Description:       Manage team members as their own content type, expose them through a public REST endpoint and list them with a block.

 * Requires at least: 6.6
 * Requires PHP:      7.4

 * License URI:       https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
 * Text Domain:       team-directory
 *

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

define( 'TEAM_DIRECTORY_VERSION', '1.0.0' );
define( 'TEAM_DIRECTORY_FILE', __FILE__ );
define( 'TEAM_DIRECTORY_DIR', plugin_dir_path( __FILE__ ) );
define( 'TEAM_DIRECTORY_URL', plugin_dir_url( __FILE__ ) );

require_once TEAM_DIRECTORY_DIR . 'includes/class-team-directory-members.php';
require_once TEAM_DIRECTORY_DIR . 'includes/class-team-directory-post-type.php';
require_once TEAM_DIRECTORY_DIR . 'includes/class-team-directory-rest-controller.php';

Team_Directory_Post_Type::init();

/**
 * Registers the REST API routes.
 *
 * @return void
 */
function team_directory_register_rest_routes() {
	$controller = new Team_Directory_REST_Controller();
	$controller->register_routes();
}
add_action( 'rest_api_init', 'team_directory_register_rest_routes' );

/**
 * Registers the Team List block from its compiled metadata.
 *
 * @return void
 */

	register_block_type( TEAM_DIRECTORY_DIR . 'build/team-list' );

 *
 * @return void

	if ( ! $screen || Team_Directory_Members::POST_TYPE !== $screen->post_type ) {
		return;

	$asset_file = TEAM_DIRECTORY_DIR . 'build/sidebar/index.asset.php';

		return;

		'team-directory-sidebar',
		TEAM_DIRECTORY_URL . 'build/sidebar/index.js',
		$asset['dependencies'],
		$asset['version'],
		true
	);

 *
 * @return void

	Team_Directory_Post_Type::register_post_type();
	flush_rewrite_rules();
}
register_activation_hook( __FILE__, 'team_directory_activate' );

/**
 * Flushes rewrite rules on deactivation.
 *
 * @return void
 */
function team_directory_deactivate() {
	flush_rewrite_rules();
}

<?php
/**
 * Shared data access for team members, used by the REST API and the block.
 *
 * @package TeamDirectory
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

/**
 * Queries and formats team members.
 */
class Team_Directory_Members {

	/**
	 * Post type slug.
	 */
	const POST_TYPE = 'tdir_member';

	/**
	 * Meta key for the member role.
	 */
	const META_ROLE = '_tdir_role';

	/**
	 * Meta key for the member start year.
	 */
	const META_START_YEAR = '_tdir_start_year';

	/**
	 * Maximum number of members per page.
	 */
	const MAX_PER_PAGE = 50;

	/**
	 * Default number of members per page.
	 */
	const DEFAULT_PER_PAGE = 10;

	/**
	 * Maximum length of a role.
	 */
	const ROLE_MAX_LENGTH = 100;

	/**
	 * Runs a query for published team members.
	 *
	 * @param array $args {
	 *     Query arguments.
	 *
	 *     @type int    $page     Page number, 1-based.
	 *     @type int    $per_page Members per page (1-50).
	 *     @type string $role     Optional role to filter by.
	 * }
	 * @return WP_Query
	 */
	public static function query( array $args = array() ) {
		$args = wp_parse_args(
			$args,
			array(
				'page'     => 1,
				'per_page' => self::DEFAULT_PER_PAGE,
				'role'     => '',
			)
		);

		$per_page = min( max( 1, (int) $args['per_page'] ), self::MAX_PER_PAGE );
		$page     = max( 1, (int) $args['page'] );
		$role     = sanitize_text_field( (string) $args['role'] );

		$query_args = array(
			'post_type'           => self::POST_TYPE,
			'post_status'         => 'publish',
			'posts_per_page'      => $per_page,
			'paged'               => $page,
			'orderby'             => array(
				'menu_order' => 'ASC',
				'title'      => 'ASC',
			),
			'ignore_sticky_posts' => true,
		);

		if ( '' !== $role ) {
			// phpcs:ignore WordPress.DB.SlowDBQuery.slow_db_query_meta_query -- Filtering by role is a core feature.
			$query_args['meta_query'] = array(
				array(
					'key'     => self::META_ROLE,
					'value'   => $role,
					'compare' => '=',
				),
			);
		}

		return new WP_Query( $query_args );
	}

	/**
	 * Returns the distinct roles used by published members.
	 *
	 * @return string[]
	 */
	public static function get_roles() {
		global $wpdb;

		$cache_key = 'roles:' . wp_cache_get_last_changed( 'posts' );
		$roles     = wp_cache_get( $cache_key, 'team_directory' );

		if ( false === $roles ) {
			// phpcs:ignore WordPress.DB.DirectDatabaseQuery.DirectQuery -- No core API for distinct meta values; cached below.
			$roles = $wpdb->get_col(
				$wpdb->prepare(
					"SELECT DISTINCT pm.meta_value
					FROM {$wpdb->postmeta} pm
					INNER JOIN {$wpdb->posts} p ON p.ID = pm.post_id
					WHERE pm.meta_key = %s
						AND pm.meta_value <> ''
						AND p.post_type = %s
						AND p.post_status = 'publish'
					ORDER BY pm.meta_value ASC",
					self::META_ROLE,
					self::POST_TYPE
				)
			);
			wp_cache_set( $cache_key, $roles, 'team_directory' );
		}

		return array_values( array_map( 'strval', (array) $roles ) );
	}

	/**
	 * Converts a member post into a plain array.
	 *
	 * @param WP_Post $post Member post.
	 * @return array
	 */
	public static function prepare( WP_Post $post ) {
		$photo    = null;
		$thumb_id = (int) get_post_thumbnail_id( $post );

		if ( $thumb_id ) {
			$src = wp_get_attachment_image_src( $thumb_id, 'medium' );
			if ( $src ) {
				$photo = array(
					'id'     => $thumb_id,
					'url'    => $src[0],
					'width'  => (int) $src[1],
					'height' => (int) $src[2],
					'alt'    => (string) get_post_meta( $thumb_id, '_wp_attachment_image_alt', true ),
				);
			}
		}

		$start_year = (int) get_post_meta( $post->ID, self::META_START_YEAR, true );

		return array(
			'id'         => $post->ID,
			'name'       => html_entity_decode( get_the_title( $post ), ENT_QUOTES, get_bloginfo( 'charset' ) ),
			'bio'        => self::get_bio( $post ),
			'role'       => (string) get_post_meta( $post->ID, self::META_ROLE, true ),
			'start_year' => $start_year > 0 ? $start_year : null,
			'photo'      => $photo,
			'link'       => get_permalink( $post ),
		);
	}

	/**
	 * Returns the member bio as plain text.
	 *
	 * Only basic text blocks are rendered, which prevents recursion if a
	 * member bio contains a Team List block.
	 *
	 * @param WP_Post $post Member post.
	 * @return string
	 */
	public static function get_bio( WP_Post $post ) {
		$content = excerpt_remove_blocks( strip_shortcodes( $post->post_content ) );
		$content = wp_strip_all_tags( $content );
		$content = html_entity_decode( $content, ENT_QUOTES, get_bloginfo( 'charset' ) );
		$content = preg_replace( "/\n{3,}/", "\n\n", str_replace( "\r", '', $content ) );

		return trim( (string) $content );
	}
}

					"SELECT DISTINCT pm.meta_value
					FROM {$wpdb->postmeta} pm
					INNER JOIN {$wpdb->posts} p ON p.ID = pm.post_id
					WHERE pm.meta_key = %s
						AND pm.meta_value <> ''
						AND p.post_type = %s
						AND p.post_status = 'publish'
					ORDER BY pm.meta_value ASC",
					self::META_ROLE,
					self::POST_TYPE
				)
			);
			wp_cache_set( $cache_key, $roles, 'team_directory' );
		}

	}

	/**
	 * Converts a member post into a plain array.
	 *
	 * @param WP_Post $post Member post.
	 * @return array
	 */
	public static function prepare( WP_Post $post ) {
		$photo    = null;
		$thumb_id = (int) get_post_thumbnail_id( $post );

		if ( $thumb_id ) {
			$src = wp_get_attachment_image_src( $thumb_id, 'medium' );
			if ( $src ) {
				$photo = array(
					'id'     => $thumb_id,
					'url'    => $src[0],
					'width'  => (int) $src[1],
					'height' => (int) $src[2],
					'alt'    => (string) get_post_meta( $thumb_id, '_wp_attachment_image_alt', true ),
				);
			}
		}

		$start_year = (int) get_post_meta( $post->ID, self::META_START_YEAR, true );

		return array(
			'id'         => $post->ID,
			'name'       => html_entity_decode( get_the_title( $post ), ENT_QUOTES, get_bloginfo( 'charset' ) ),
			'bio'        => self::get_bio( $post ),
			'role'       => (string) get_post_meta( $post->ID, self::META_ROLE, true ),
			'start_year' => $start_year > 0 ? $start_year : null,
			'photo'      => $photo,
			'link'       => get_permalink( $post ),
		);

	 * member bio contains a Team List block.
	 *
	 * @param WP_Post $post Member post.
	 * @return string

	public static function get_bio( WP_Post $post ) {
		$content = excerpt_remove_blocks( strip_shortcodes( $post->post_content ) );
		$content = wp_strip_all_tags( $content );
		$content = html_entity_decode( $content, ENT_QUOTES, get_bloginfo( 'charset' ) );
		$content = preg_replace( "/\n{3,}/", "\n\n", str_replace( "\r", '', $content ) );

		return trim( (string) $content );
	}

<?php
/**
 * REST API controller for team members.
 *
 * Routes (namespace team-directory/v1):
 * - GET            /members             List published members (public, paginated, filterable by role).
 * - POST|PUT|PATCH /members/{id}/role   Change a member's role (requires edit_post on that member).
 * - GET            /roles               List distinct roles in use (public).
 *
 * @package TeamDirectory
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

/**
 * Team Directory REST controller.
 */
class Team_Directory_REST_Controller extends WP_REST_Controller {

	/**
	 * Constructor.
	 */
	public function __construct() {
		$this->namespace = 'team-directory/v1';
		$this->rest_base = 'members';
	}

	/**
	 * Registers the routes.
	 *
	 * @return void
	 */
	public function register_routes() {
		register_rest_route(
			$this->namespace,
			'/' . $this->rest_base,
			array(
				array(
					'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
					'callback'            => array( $this, 'get_items' ),
					'permission_callback' => array( $this, 'get_items_permissions_check' ),
					'args'                => $this->get_collection_params(),
				),
				'schema' => array( $this, 'get_public_item_schema' ),
			)
		);

		register_rest_route(
			$this->namespace,
			'/' . $this->rest_base . '/(?P<id>[\d]+)/role',
			array(
				'args'   => array(
					'id' => array(
						'description'       => __( 'Unique identifier for the team member.', 'team-directory' ),
						'type'              => 'integer',
						'minimum'           => 1,
						'validate_callback' => 'rest_validate_request_arg',
						'sanitize_callback' => 'absint',
					),
				),
				array(
					'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::EDITABLE,
					'callback'            => array( $this, 'update_role' ),
					'permission_callback' => array( $this, 'update_role_permissions_check' ),
					'args'                => array(
						'role' => array(
							'description'       => __( 'New role for the team member.', 'team-directory' ),
							'type'              => 'string',
							'required'          => true,
							'maxLength'         => Team_Directory_Members::ROLE_MAX_LENGTH,
							'validate_callback' => array( $this, 'validate_role' ),
							'sanitize_callback' => 'sanitize_text_field',
						),
					),
				),
				'schema' => array( $this, 'get_public_item_schema' ),
			)
		);

		register_rest_route(
			$this->namespace,
			'/roles',
			array(
				array(
					'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
					'callback'            => array( $this, 'get_roles' ),
					'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
				),
			)
		);
	}

	/**
	 * The member list is public.
	 *
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Request.
	 * @return true
	 */
	public function get_items_permissions_check( $request ) {
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Lists members.
	 *
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Request.
	 * @return WP_REST_Response|WP_Error
	 */

=== Team Directory ===

Manage team members, expose them via a public REST endpoint, and list them with a block.

== Description ==

* "Team Members" post type: title = name, content = bio, featured image = photo.
* Role and start year are edited in the "Member details" panel of the document sidebar.
* "Team List" block: live preview in the editor, rendered on the server on the front end.

= REST API =

`GET /wp-json/team-directory/v1/members`

* `page` (int, default 1)
* `per_page` (int, 1-50, default 10)
* `role` (string, optional exact role match)

The response is an array of members. Totals are in the `X-WP-Total` and
`X-WP-TotalPages` headers, and `Link` headers point to the previous and next pages.

`POST|PUT|PATCH /wp-json/team-directory/v1/members/{id}/role` with body `{ "role": "Designer" }`

The user must be able to edit that member (`edit_post`). With cookie authentication, send an `X-WP-Nonce` header (`wp_rest` nonce). An empty or missing role returns `400 rest_invalid_param`. An unknown ID returns `404 rest_member_invalid_id`, and a user without permission gets `401`/`403 rest_cannot_edit`.

`GET /wp-json/team-directory/v1/roles` returns the roles currently in use.

== Development ==

    npm install
    npm run build

I wrote the Team Directory plugin under `./output/team-directory/`. As you asked, I didn't run `npm install`, a build or any other command, so none of it has been tested. Until `npm run build` runs, the block and the sidebar panel won't load, because they need the `build/` folder; the plugin skips them rather than erroring.

**Files:**
- `team-directory.php`: the main plugin file. It hooks everything up, loads the sidebar panel only on member edit screens, and resets permalinks on activation and deactivation.
- `includes/class-team-directory-members.php`: shared code that fetches and formats members, used by both the endpoint and the block.
- `includes/class-team-directory-post-type.php`: the "Team Members" content type. Name is the title, bio is the content, and photo is the featured image. Role and start year are saved with the member, and only people who can edit that member can change them.
- `includes/class-team-directory-rest-controller.php`: the endpoints under `team-directory/v1`:
  - `GET /members` is public. It takes `page`, `per_page` (1–50) and `role`. The totals are in the `X-WP-Total` and `X-WP-TotalPages` headers, and `Link` headers point to the previous and next pages.
  - `POST/PUT/PATCH /members/{id}/role` only works for a user allowed to edit that member. An empty role, an unknown ID or a page past the end is rejected with a clear error.
  - `GET /roles` is an extra I added that lists the roles in use. It fills the block's role filter.
- `src/sidebar/index.js`: the "Member details" panel in the document sidebar, with fields for role and start year.
- `src/team-list/block.json`, `index.js`, `edit.js`, `render.php`, `style.scss`, `editor.scss`: the Team List block. The editor shows a live preview from the endpoint with a role filter, a number-of-members setting, photo and bio toggles, and a loading spinner. The front end is rendered on the server.
- `package.json` and `webpack.config.js`: the build setup with `@wordpress/scripts`. The webpack config adds the sidebar as a second build entry next to the block.
- `readme.txt`: a short description and the endpoint docs.

Behaviours to know about:
- **Bio is plain text in the endpoint.** HTML is stripped, and only basic text blocks are kept, so a member's bio can't contain a Team List block that loops forever.
- **Bad start years are cleared without a warning.** A year before 1900 or after next year is saved as empty, and the editor shows no error.
- **Requires WordPress 6.6 or later.**
